references.comment: Incorrect end time calculation using slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime

Using === for dayjs object comparison will always return false as it compares object references, not values. Use .isSame() method instead: dayjs(date.start).add(utcOffset, 'minutes').isSame(dayjs(date.end).add(utcOffset, minutes))

rows.label: match
rows.reason: Both identify the same bug: using === to compare two Dayjs objects (reference equality) instead of .isSame(), at the same line in slots.ts.

rows.label: match
